title: reject cross-family set-operation branches at build time

basis: D25; the 42804 measurement in #503; hejbro never stricter than Postgres (plpgsql-function-bodies precedent); #489's within-family scope
decisions.title: Cross-family set-operation branches are refused at build time by a measured pair table; unknown is a wildcard; #489 stays separate
#966 folds into this change: the recursive anchor/term pair is the third surface
the measurement protocol: 42804 alone means refused, union all, one representative per family plus a homogeneity sweep
never only for two single-literal families the table refuses; every other shape is accepted; core's type-test naming
